name: border-radius
author: liyun,linyiyi
desc: The border-radius CSS property rounds the corners of an element's outer border edge.

android.notes: The new animator supports transitions and @keyframes for this shorthand and expands it to the four physical corner longhands. px endpoints and percentage endpoints animate per x/y component. px-to-percentage and mixed calc() endpoints are not animated. The legacy animator ignores border-radius animation.
